correctness.rationale: An exact even-boundary bijection establishes all independent-set counts, and a trigonometric identity locates all simple negative roots. Necessary and sufficient gap conditions classify every maximal packing and yield the complete bivariate rational generating function. A one-unit-slack comparison proves the optimum exchange graph is exactly a chain of m triangles at even order and a singleton at odd order. The independent finite exhaustive checker matches every claimed invariant through n=12; that check is corroboration rather than the infinite proof.
